subject: Nook: WhatsApp ordering and closure trust
body:
Hi,

We noticed Nook was listed as currently closed on Snapchat while founder the Founder of Grace Coffee Co., Nook & The Backyard appeared at the NRAI Food Delivery Summit about Grace Coffee Co. and promoted a cranberry cold brew. The same single cafe also relies heavily on Swiggy, Zomato and District for discovery, reservations and delivery.

For a small cafe with no evidenced owned web or app, that creates both trust and margin risk. Swiggy, Zomato and District commissions plus deep discounts can erode the margin that specialty coffee depends on, and there is no owned customer path for repeat visits.

We would value a short call to walk through the top opportunity: a WhatsApp Business ordering and loyalty loop for Nook.

I've attached a one-page summary.

[Your Name]
